Your mission will be to understand the fundamentals of cloud infrastructure (systems, networking, virtualization) and help customers resolve technical issues. Your role will be to serve as the technical point of contact for our customers (tickets and phone) on topics related to cloud infrastructure and products. Your mission: analyze, diagnose, and guide customers in resolving their incidents. Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities. Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches. Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life. International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French. Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers. 🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure ? ✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI. ✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges. ✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification. 🔜 THE NEXT STEPS… Discovery call with a recruiter (30 min) Interview with the manager to understand your technical skills and approach to the role (60 min) HR interview to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues Version Française : ici Scaleway is a company certified under SecNumCloud. Jouw technische interesse en ontwikkelbereidheid zijn doorslaggevend. Het vermogen om integraal te sturen, de juiste vragen te stellen en het projectteam richting te geven, is in deze rol doorslaggevend. Samenwerking en kennisdeling met ervaren en gemotiveerde professionals binnen je eigen Business Cell, met daarnaast toegang tot kennis, ervaring en samenwerking met specialisten uit andere Business Cells. Zo biedt TMC een ruim netwerk aan professionals uit diverse specialismen. Toegang tot ons TMC Entrepreneurial Lab, waar je je eigen ideeën en projecten tot leven kunt brengen.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 工作重心： 1.海内外财务管控体系搭建与经营风险把控 2.客户信用评级、授信管控与坏账风险防控全链条 3.银行/税务/审计/政府多方外部机构的高频对接与谈判 岗位职责： 1.全维度对外窗口对接 作为公司财务核心对外窗口，全权负责各类外部机构对接协调工作： a.银行对接：负责海内外银行账户管理、跨境收付款、结售汇、授信融资、银行对账、函证、银行业务洽谈与维护，解决跨境资金流转问题； b.税务对接：负责境内外税务合规、纳税申报核查、税务稽查应对、税收优惠申请、跨境税务政策落地，统筹税务风险管控； c.审计对接：全权对接四大/本地会计师事务所，负责内审、年审、专项审计全程配合，资料统筹、问题答疑、整改落地； d.政企对接：对接财政、工商、外管、商务等监管部门，完成各类备案、申报、核查工作。 2.. 出海财务统筹与海外沟通 具备成熟的企业出海财务实操经验，负责海外子公司、海外业务板块的财务统筹工作；独立完成海内外跨境财务沟通，协调境内外财务政策、资金流转、合规差异；处理海外业务财务风险、跨境结算、海外信用风控等专项工作，适配企业国际化经营发展需求。 3. 经营支持与专项工作 配合公司业务拓展、海外项目落地、投融资、授信年审等专项财务工作；输出风控报告、信用分析报告、对外财务资料，支撑公司经营与对外合作。 B. 任职要求： 1.方向匹配：纯正Financial Controlling财务管控方向，非纯记账、纯报表岗，精通财务风控、流程管控、经营财务管理； 2.核心能力：具备成熟的Credit Checking客户信用审核、授信管控、坏账风险防控经验； 3.对外能力：成熟的对外公关协调能力，能独立完成银行、税务、审计、监管机构全维度对接、谈判与问题处理； 4.出海经验：具备企业出海/海外子公司管理/跨境财务实操经验，可独立开展海外财务对接与跨境沟通； 5.行业适配：有制造业、进出口贸易、跨境企业财务管控经验者优先； 6.软性素质：风险敏感度高，逻辑清晰，抗压性强，沟通谈判能力突出，具备极强的问题解决能力与闭环意识； 7.证书加分：CPA、ACCA、中级会计职称优先。
